title.value: PromptMix: A Class Boundary Augmentation Method for Large Language Model Distillation
title.justification: The chosen title accurately reflects the content of the paper, which is focused on the PromptMix method for generating data near class boundaries for language model distillation.

extractions.description: The paper presents PromptMix, a method for data augmentation in text classification using few-shot and zero-shot learning scenarios. It leverages large language models to generate augmented data near class boundaries and employs a relabeling technique to improve label accuracy. The method improves the performance of smaller models by transferring knowledge from large language models like GPT3.5-turbo into smaller ones like DistilBERT and BERT.
